message: The other day, we were tracking a winter storm, and our family group chat turned into a mix of weather updates and playful memes about our impending snowed-in status. While my kids debated the merits of hot cocoa versus popcorn, I found myself jotting down a quick checklist to make sure we had everything we needed. Who knew a storm could spark such creativity? It’s nice to be prepared, but it’s even better to find some joy in the chaos.
